title: Loudoun Phase 2 Data Center Standards and Locations Project
summary: Loudoun County's Phase 2 project records an approved work plan to consider data-center compatibility, special-exception review, operational needs, mitigation, and redevelopment.
key_findings: The Board of Supervisors approved the Phase 2 project plan on September 16, 2025.
The work is intended to evaluate compatibility issues through the special-exception process.
The active project is not adopted ordinance text or a facility-specific approval.
why_it_matters: The record makes local acceptance and land-use rules a traceable implementation gate.
ftfn_relevance: Adds the policy-development record to the corridor dossier.
Separates project planning from adopted and effective standards.
evidence_limits: The page does not establish final Phase 2 text or an effective date.
It does not prove project compliance or community outcomes.
